project.title: Metagenomic sequencing reveals mineral EPS shell densification and selective loss of active granules in a CANDAN system
project.description: This project provides shotgun metagenomic sequencing data of granular sludge from a 9 L laboratory scale Complete Ammonium and Nitrate Removal via Denitratation Anammox over Nitrite CANDAN sequencing batch reactor, to investigate the evolutionary pathway from functional deterioration to spontaneous granule flotation and reactor collapse.According to settling behavior and particle size, the sludge granules were divided into three fractions, floating granules F, large settling granules SL, small settling granules SS. Total genomic DNA was extracted from each fraction separately, and paired end shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed on the DNBSEQ T7 platform.These sequencing data support comparative analyses of microbial community structure, nitrogen metabolism functional genes, and central carbon metabolic pathways across the three granule types. Combined with long term reactor performance monitoring, physicochemical characterization, EPS composition analysis and mineral distribution detection, the data help demonstrate a self reinforcing destabilization mechanism. The functional shift toward enhanced complete denitrification elevated reactor pH, promoted Ca P mineral precipitation and peripheral enrichment of proteinaceous EPS on granule surfaces, and jointly formed a dense gas impermeable mineral EPS shell. The restricted gas diffusion caused internal N2 retention in highly active anammox granules, induced granule flotation, and the subsequent selective washout of these active biomass fractions further accelerated CANDAN system deterioration.
